aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab makes practical software for food truck and mobile catering operators. Online orders, pickup time management, fewer repeated enquiries. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About the company — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We make practical software for food truck and mobile catering operators. We help them take online orders, manage pickup times, keep orders flowing smoothly, and spend less time on repeated enquiries.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was made to change this.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet most of the software they can use is designed around businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our goal is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools fitted to how these businesses actually operate.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab began with a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their business.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After making Village Foodie, a directory that helps people easily find food trucks coming to their neighbourhood, I came to learn more deeply about the difficulties mobile food businesses face. Unlike ordinary restaurants, food trucks are always moving, serving customers in many places and in conditions that change each time.

comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see pickup times the kitchen can actually meet. The system calculates from each dish’s cooking time and how many can be made at once.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does it stop orders piling up in my kitchen?
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also carry Stripe fees: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.costQ: How much does HatchGrab cost in {country}?
comparison.faq.costTrial: {months, plural, one {The first month} other {The first # months}}: every feature free to use.
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. Set up a weekly trading schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and date where the food truck is.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Can I use it if my trading spot changes?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay on the spot at the food truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported at the moment.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum contract period and no cancellation notice period. You can cancel any time; the fee is billed monthly in advance and you can keep using it until the end of the month you paid for.
comparison.faq.termQ: Is there a minimum contract period?
comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a POS and has no tax certification function. Talk to your tax accountant about how to record online orders in your POS.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a POS that meets tax requirements?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers reach the food truck. Customers choose dishes and a pickup time, pay online or when they pick up, and the order shows straight away in the kitchen. A POS or card terminal takes payment at the food truck itself. The two complement each other.

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Download sales, tax and refunds for any month, quarter or fiscal year, ready to send to your tax accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Customers can pre-order for a later date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically, no need to accept each one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Put your logo in your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Assign a buzzer number to an order when you hand one out, so you know which buzzer is which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen where customers can see order numbers and whether they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck shows on the public HatchGrab map so nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates, such as hygiene training, insurance and gas safety checks, in one place. We tell you before they expire, and you can send them to an event or market organiser with one tap.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming schedule on your website. Each date links straight to its ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types with prices and settings suited to events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to use HatchGrab. It gives a live kitchen display (KDS) and is the only way to keep taking orders when the signal drops.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. Once a slot is full, customers can’t choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital stamp cards. Collecting and redeeming are handled automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Bundle items into set menus and suggest extra items at checkout to raise the average order value.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: The same as WhatsApp auto-replies, for Messenger and Instagram enquiries.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Several screens, such as counter and kitchen, can all show the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Create individual logins for each staff member with the right permissions.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If the signal drops, online ordering pauses so customers can’t place orders you can’t see. With the iPhone, iPad and Android app you keep taking orders offline; the web dashboard needs an internet connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment in advance via Stripe when customers order online.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a pre-order deadline for items that need advance notice.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that are not shown on the map, and get their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Enter each item’s cost and see the profit you actually made at every event, not just sales.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill your schedule automatically from your website or a photo you already post on Facebook. Just check and approve.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically text customers when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs and we add dates, places and times automatically for each week and event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item sold out with one tap and it shows greyed out on customers’ screens straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock quantity and it goes down with each order, then marks sold out automatically when gone.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone, so you don’t need a separate card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a pickup time slot, so orders spread evenly across your trading hours.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders on site, with payment taken on your own card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your trading from a browser on any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Automatically answers WhatsApp enquiries about your menu and schedule.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at once and how long it takes. Once a pickup time is full, customers can’t choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the vehicle, and even the card terminal you already use for payments.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, stable wifi and the same opening hours every week. But you trade somewhere new each week, at different times, where mobile data is weak or absent. HatchGrab was made for exactly that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If the signal drops, online ordering pauses automatically so customers can’t place orders you can’t see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in the dates, places and times so it is ready to share — weekly or daily.
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a pickup time. Queues get shorter, and the food is ready when they arrive.

landing.does.title: Made for food trucks, not restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you trading tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Even while you drive to the venue or stand at the grill, WhatsApp enquiries get answered automatically using your menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram supported soon.
